steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Turn [your logo] into a 10-second reel, vertical 9:16 at 1080x1920, 30 fps, with every word inside the TikTok, Reels and Shorts safe zone.

Ask me for the logo as an SVG, the brand colours and, if I have one, a reference video whose energy I like.

Story:
1. The logo's parts arrive one by one from off screen.
2. They assemble with a satisfying snap on the beat.
3. A light sweep crosses the finished mark.
4. The name and a short tagline type on underneath.

Look and motion: bold and dynamic, like a world-class motion designer's logo animation: strong easing, overshoot, and every part moving with intent.

Sound: compose a short original track in code, or use a royalty-free one and tell me where it is from. Give every cut and reveal its own sound effect, land the cuts on the beat, and mix so nothing clips.

How to build it: draw every frame in code as a pure function of time (HTML, Canvas or SVG, Remotion or HyperFrames all work), render the frames headlessly and assemble an MP4 with the audio. Then watch your render at full speed and fix anything that feels slow, cramped, generic or off-brand before you hand it over.

original.label: Prompt
original.text: Make this PayBox logo into a reel. Pretend you are a world-class motion designer. Make a 10-second dynamic video like the reference
